page_title: VIL 5-1 VLL | Villarreal v Valladolid 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Isidro Diaz has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' 5 - 1 What a screamer! The ball falls to Selim Amallah (Valladolid) on the edge of the box after several rebounds and he doesn't hesitate to rifle it off the bar and behind the keeper.
90+3' Golden opportunity! Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.

90+1' 5 - 0 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Denis Suarez (Villarreal) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
86' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the middle of the net.
86' 4 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Denis Suarez picks out Thierno Barry (Villarreal) with a sweet pass, and he latches on to it deep inside the box and beats the goalkeeper. 4:0.
85' Chance! Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
85' Villarreal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
82' Valladolid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' Diego Cocca prepares a substitution. Chuki is replaced by Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid).
76' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Denis Suarez (Villarreal) replaces Yeremy Pino.
75' The current number of shots on goal is 6:1.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) replaces Mamadou Sylla.
71' Substitution. Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Stanko Juric walks off.

70' 3 - 0 Sergi Cardona produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Santi Comesana (Villarreal) rises high to head the ball into the middle of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 3:0.
68' Substitution. Pape Gueye makes way for Dani Parejo (Villarreal).
68' Here is a change. Ayoze Perez is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Thierno Barry (Villarreal).
67' The ball is out of play. Villarreal win a corner kick.
66' The game is interrupted. Selim Amallah (Valladolid) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.

64' 2 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Pape Gueye (Villarreal) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Karl Hein, so the score changes to 2:0.
63' Good movement by Chuki (Valladolid), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is replacing Gerard Moreno.
60' The attendance is 17032.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valladolid.
57' A corner kick by Valladolid is thwarted by the well prepared Diego Conde (Villarreal).
56' Valladolid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
55' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
52' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Karl Hein makes a great save to stop his effort.
51' Alex Baena (Villarreal) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar.
50' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
49' A pass from Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is intercepted by Karl Hein and the move breaks down.
48' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
46' Half-time substitution. Marcelino decided to make a change. Kiko Femenia is replaced by Pau Navarro (Villarreal).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
45' Golden chance! Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.

42' 1 - 0 That's scrappy, but it's a GOAL! The long throw into the box comically bobbles around until pounced on by Ayoze Perez (Villarreal), who scuffs the ball into the net from inside the six-yard box. It's now 1:0.
38' Chuki (Valladolid) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
37' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
36' Villarreal are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
36' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz had an easy-decision to make.
35' Isidro Diaz blows his whistle and it's Selim Amallah (Valladolid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
34' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) plays a through ball but overhits it.
31' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) sends in a cross from the free-kick from the edge of the box. His effort is inaccurate and goes out of play.
30' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
30' Luis Perez (Valladolid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
29' Alex Baena (Villarreal) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
28' Isidro Diaz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) and blew his whistle.
26' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
24' Excellent touch by Ayoze Perez (Villarreal)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
21' Chuki (Valladolid) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the right side of the goal. Diego Conde is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
21' A quickly taken corner by Valladolid.
20' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Chuki (Valladolid) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
19' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Alex Baena (Villarreal) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
15' Alex Baena (Villarreal) dinks a fine lofted pass from the free kick. However, one of the defenders heads the ball out of danger.
15' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) commits a rough challenge and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for an infringement.
13' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) commits a foul during an attacking move.
10' Wonderful movement by Villarreal. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
9' Villarreal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
4' Valladolid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
3' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
